n_b, budget = map(int, input().split())
array = list(map(int, input().split()))

parityCounter = [0] * n_b
parityCounter[0] = 1 if array[0] % 2 == 1 else -1

for i in range(1, n_b):
    if array[i] % 2 == 1:
        parityCounter[i] = parityCounter[i - 1] + 1
    else:
        parityCounter[i] = parityCounter[i - 1] - 1

diffArray = [abs(array[i + 1] - array[i]) for i in range(n_b - 1)]

costs = []
for i in range(1, n_b - 1):
    if parityCounter[i] == 0:
        costs.append(diffArray[i])

costs.sort()

used = 0
for c in costs:
    if budget >= c:
        budget -= c
        used += 1
    else:
        break

print(used)
</translated_code>
